fingerprint_inputs.task_fingerprint: md5(ANNIE V2 (a-anie-site).md) — the loop's task ledger
fingerprint_inputs.worktree_fingerprint: md5(sorted untracked-file list) — includes the 4 known untracked files; do not auto-trigger on their presence
fingerprint_inputs.test_state_fingerprint: md5(sorted per-test RUN/SKIPPED list from harness/scripts/smoke.sh) — detects test regressions (RUN->FAIL, RUN->SKIPPED, or new tests)
fingerprint_inputs.git_fingerprint: md5(sorted git ls-files output) — HEAD-independent so the file is transparent to its own amend
fingerprint_inputs.authorization_fingerprint: sentinel label for the current authorization regime; change when the user gives a new top-level instruction set

no_op_rule: A repeated loop invocation is NO-OP if and only if all six fingerprints match the recomputed values AND last_outcome in {completed, no-op, decision-required} does not indicate an outstanding action.
rewrite_rule: Rewrite this file ONLY on a real state transition (new commit, new task, new authorization, test regression, open-question status change). A no-op must not rewrite this file.
notes: Bootstrap fingerprint. last_processed_head points to the prior committed milestone (7d486f6, feat: harden ANNIE recording and navigation flows). The HEAD on disk is the bootstrap commit itself. The git_fingerprint is intentionally HEAD-independent (it hashes only the tracked-file set, not HEAD or branch) so the file is transparent to amend cycles. HEAD and branch are stored as separate top-level fields. Loop-iteration counter, PID, cwd, and timestamps are deliberately excluded from fingerprints so a no-op does not appear as a change.
